blocks.text: Know when a release needs attention.
See what changed after your rollout, compare health by reported version, and move from a bad signal to the devices and logs behind it.
Mark the version, channel, and deployment date.
Compare reported health before support tickets arrive.
Follow the trend into errors, versions, and devices.
All reported app versions · Last 12 days
Capgo Observe dashboard showing native health, launch timing, WebView timing, version breakdown, and release markers
Stop treating production as a black box
Your rollout is only done when you know what happened next.
Observe gives every release a health view, then gives you the evidence to decide what deserves action.
See issue-free devices, native issues, launch P90, and WebView P90 for the reported versions in one view.
Use release markers for version, channel, and deployment date as you read the signals.
Use grouped failures, affected versions, devices, and action logs to investigate a trend.
See the release, not just the metric
Start broad. Narrow fast. Know where to look next.
Read all-version health, compare the versions that diverge, and use the release marker to connect the change to the impact.
Read issue-free devices, native issues, launch P90, and WebView P90 before narrowing your investigation.
Compare reported app versions when health or timing differs from the overall picture.
Separate launches, WebView loads, native issues, and update activity while you investigate a trend in Logs Insights.
Do not hand your team a chart. Hand them the trail.
See which reported version changed the release picture.
Compare health and timing with the context of what you deployed, where, and when.
Identify the errors, versions, and devices behind the trend.
Use Logs Insights to group errors by category, follow the daily trend, and identify affected versions and devices. Then open filtered raw action logs for the details.

blocks.text: Being able to add Device ID's to certain groups and push the changes to only certain groups is a life saver.
Getting set up took less than a day. Channel-based rollouts let me test on my own device before anything hits production users.
Put deployment history, release health, and Logs Insights in one release workflow.
